resources.string: MinCalSync needs access to your calendars.
Tip: create an empty calendar in Google Calendar and use it as target.
Lets the system run the sync in the background. Important on Xiaomi/HyperOS.
Not started: choose source and target calendar
Error: target calendar missing or read-only

What does it do?
Copies events from a source calendar (e.g. Exchange) into a target calendar (e.g. Google). One way only: changes in the target are not copied back.

Setup
1. Exchange and Google accounts must be set up in Android and syncing their calendars.
2. Create an empty calendar in Google Calendar (e.g. "Work") and choose it as target. This keeps copies and your own events apart.
3. Choose source and target, switch on automatic sync.

Google Home
Google Home app → profile → Home settings → Google Assistant → Calendar: enable the target calendar. "Personal results" must be on.

What is synced?
Events from 30 days ago to 365 days ahead. Recurring events are copied as single events. Older copies are kept but no longer updated.

Safety
MinCalSync only changes or deletes events it created itself. Your own events in the target calendar are never touched. If you delete a copy by hand, the next sync recreates it as long as it exists in the source.

Sync does not run?
Xiaomi/HyperOS likes to stop background apps. Tap "No battery restrictions" and under Settings → Apps → MinCalSync allow autostart.

Save / load
The icons at the top store interval and auto sync in a file and restore them. Source and target calendar are chosen again on each phone.
